title: Demon at Eternity Support Desk
description: A horned demon with red ribbons stands at a glowing cyberpunk service counter, holding a long receipt while speaking to two seated human support agents. The neon-lit background is covered in chaotic handwritten text, floating symbols, and a digital sign reading 'SPELL SUPPORT - CURRENT WAIT: ETERNITY'.
prompt: A demonic figure with black horns and flowing red ribbons stands at a futuristic service counter, holding a very long glowing receipt. Two bored human agents sit behind the desk with computer monitors and a service bell. The entire scene is covered in glowing purple and cyan handwritten text and symbols. A digital sign overhead reads SPELL SUPPORT - CURRENT WAIT: ETERNITY with a skull logo. Chaotic cyberpunk hell aesthetic, digital painting.
